historicalScope: Generic German-crewed launch, skiff and patrol vessel chosen for gameplay; these are not identified historical boat classes or evidence of their presence at Solta in May 1944.
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: production 2D top-down game sprite atlas, six isolated sprites on genuinely transparent background. Reference image 1 is the exact accepted player's boat hull and painting style; image 2 is only the game's terrain/palette context, do not draw water or land. Make a neat atlas of 2 columns by 3 rows, large landscape canvas. Every row contains the SAME vessel twice: intact on left, permanently wrecked on right, aligned with identical hull scale and bow direction. All bows point to the RIGHT, exact straight-down orthographic plan view, no visible vertical side walls, no isometric perspective, no cast shadows outside hull. Row 1: German occupied motor launch, the same hull shape and proportions as reference 1, dark weathered olive hull, wooden rear deck, small forward bow machine gun, 3 German soldiers in field-grey uniforms with dark grey WWII helmets, grey uniform and helmet silhouettes readable at 178x76 px. Row 2: clearly SMALLER open motor skiff 4.5m long, pointed narrow hull, grey-green paint, 2 helmeted German crew, a single small forward machine gun; about 63% of row 1 hull length at same scale. Row 3: clearly larger patrol launch 12m long, slim steel-grey green hull with a small low central wheelhouse, timber stern decking, a simple bow machine gun and 4 helmeted crew; about 169% of row 1 length, still far smaller and simpler than a 33m Schnellboot; no torpedoes. Right column wrecks: keep outer footprint, bow direction and exact hull dimensions, recognizable broken gun, splintered decks, dark burnt structural damage, crew no longer standing, no flames, no smoke, no wake, no water, no effects. Three sprites must have distinct realistic silhouettes and coherent relative size. Semi-realistic compact raster game art like reference 1, muted WWII Adriatic colors, strong readable edges, minimal fine detail, not cartoons and not glossy 3D. Keep generous transparent gutters around all six sprites, never overlap or clip. No letters, labels, flags, badges, emblems, stars, text or swastikas. Final target lengths 178px launch,113px skiff,300px patrol ship; draw details for that final small display size. Need clean actual transparent alpha, not a checkerboard.
